entry.title: TinySA Ultra+
entry.summary:
Vendor: Zeenko
Type: SDR
Price: 163.00

Introduction

Spectrum Analysers allow you to observe radio signals visually in real-time.

For pentesters working with RF, Remotes or IoT, this tool allows you to quickly identify a target device's frequency, so you can prepare an appropriate attack: A classic example would be to identify the frequency of a target remote control: 30MHz, 433MHz or 866MHz.

The TinySA is an affordable, pocket-sized portable powerhouse, working from 100kHz to to 960MHz. On the go, use its touchscreen - at the desk, it connects to your workstation expanded functionality. 

The TinySA also has a built-in signal generator (useful for tests, or even close-range roll-jam functionality) capable of generating sine & square-wave signals from 0.1MHz - 950MHz.

As an Open Source device, there are multiple versions available. Lab401 stocks the TinySA Ultra Plus - the most recent, powerful and CE compliant version.

Portable

Pocket-sized with internal battery & touch-screen.

Powerful

Desktop & mobile apps provide extra functionality.

Device Specifications

  • Frequency Range: 100kHz - 900MHz, 5.4GHz in Ultra mode, 10GHz in Harmonic Mode
  • Bandpass Filters: 2.6KHz - 640KHz
  • Inbuilt Attenuator: -31dB > 0dB
  • Resolution: 200kHz to 850KHz
  • Display Points Per Scan: up to 450
  • Signal Generator:
    • Sine: 0.1MHz - 350MHz
    • Square: 250MHz - 960MHz
  • Calibration: Automatic
  • Display: 4" Touchscreen 480x320 TFT
  • Dimensions: 117mm x 72mm x 22mm 
  • Connectivity: USB-C

What's included

  • 1x TinySA Ultra+
  • 1x Telescopic SMA Antenna
  • 1x Female-Female SMA through connector
  • 2x SMA Male-Male extension cables
  • 1x USB-A to USB-C Cable
